description.pl: Automatyczne porządkowanie plików w katalogu według rozszerzenia. Przenosi pliki do podkatalogów (Images, Documents, Videos, Music, Archives, Code).
description.en: Automatically organizes files in a directory by extension. Moves files into subdirectories (Images, Documents, Videos, Music, Archives, Code).

en: Organizes files into folders by type
Supports dry-run mode to preview changes
Auto-detects common file types and extensions
